title: Computation of the Amount to Settle a Retrofit Project At
content:
# Computation of the Amount to Settle a Retrofit Project At

The amount an owner settles a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects at is worked out from what stands on the project's account, the retainage on it, the late fees raised on it and the credits standing against it.

**Everything settled now.** Everything settled now is every deposit, mobilisation, progress, change order and remobilisation billing raised on the project, whether or not its due day has passed.

**The retainage withheld.** The retainage withheld from those billings is taken off, the owner never having been invoiced for it.

**The retainage released.** None of the retainage released on the project is settled with the balance: 0 per cent of it.

**The late fees.** No late fee raised on the project is settled with the balance: 0 per cent of them.

**The credits.** Half of every credit issued on the project, that is 50 per cent of them, is taken off the settlement, and the rest is taken off when the retainage held on it is released.

**The portfolio allowance.** No portfolio allowance is taken off: the allowance is 0 per cent of the figure settled.

**The amount to settle.** The amount to settle is everything settled now, less the retainage withheld from those billings, plus the retainage released settled with the balance, plus the late fees settled with the balance, less every payment received and less the credits taken off. That figure is then reduced by the portfolio allowance taken on it, the result is rounded to the nearest cent, and where it falls below zero nothing is settled.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

| Quantity | Figure |
|---|---|
| deposit, mobilisation, progress, change order and remobilisation billings raised | USD 260000.00 |
| retainage withheld from those billings | USD 20000.00 |
| retainage released, settled with the balance | USD 0.00 |
| late fees raised, settled with the balance | USD 0.00 |
| payments received | USD 180000.00 |
| credits issued USD 6000, taken off at 50 per cent | USD 3000.00 |
| the figure before the allowance | USD 57000.00 |
| portfolio allowance | USD 0.00 |
| amount to settle | USD 57000.00 |

Where the payments received and the retainage withheld together come to more than the billings raised, the figure falls below zero and nothing is settled.
